mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a current temperature of 62 degrees under overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School.

The City of Verona is reminding residents to be wary of scams involving planning fees. Official payments must be made by check at City Hall. Additionally, the City Council has approved new sewer and stormwater rates to ensure our utilities remain self-supporting and well-maintained.

It is a busy week in our city. Today, Epic Systems is hosting its annual User Group Meeting, and later tonight you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, we have farmers market activities, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia, followed by our final Concerts in the Park on August 20.

During the week of August 10 to August 17, the Verona Police Department handled numerous calls. Specifically, on Saturday, August 15, a 29-year-old man was arrested for his second O W I offence following a report of a reckless driver.
Today's flavor is Caramel Chocolate Pecan. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open their doors at 10 AM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor of the day is Double Strawberry.
